overview_description.description: Fiz is a grocery delivery platform intended to offer food and grocery products. They provide fast grocery delivery solutions. Their platform facilitates users to browse an assortment of groceries, baked goods, fresh produce, cleaning, and personal products. It aims to deliver approximately 1,500 stock-keeping units (SKUs) in 10–15 minutes.
